t: Three specific things a devil does
a: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ السَّمِيعِ الْعَلِيمِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ مِنْ هَمْزِهِ وَنَفْخِهِ وَنَفْثِهِ
p: Aʿūdhu bi-Llāhi-s-samīʿi-l-ʿalīmi mina-sh-shayṭāni-r-rajīm, min hamzihi wa nafkhihi wa nafthih
m: I seek refuge in Allah, the Hearing, the Knowing, from the rejected Satan: from his prodding, his puffing up, and his blowing.
